scope: Development fix of the reported two-up / one-down path in system Chrome; not formal release acceptance
rootCause: ChatGPT unmounts entire offscreen rounds while retaining spacer geometry. Rebuilding pages from only mounted nodes loses already-observed next/previous questions.

fix.history: Per-dock, per-document observed stable ChatGPT user keys and geometry; no message text or detached node retention.
fix.invalidation: Route/root/main/scroller/selector/site, scroll and viewport dimensions, stable anchor/cover drift, role/identity ambiguity, disable and disposal; no history for custom adapters or other origins.
fix.landing: At most two verified live-question corrections, 180ms and 600ms after a trusted page jump; canceled by user scroll/touch/navigation key, outside pointer input, context or dimensions change, replacement action, disable or disposal.
fix.count: Observed and verified rounds only, never an invented server-side total.

checks: current source files equal original builder metadata
compiled program bytes equal frozen draft and package source
formal delivery bytes equal installed candidate
version/revision/catalog and original three-site USER_SCRIPT rules match

nativeChrome.update: Original Extensions > Import > v0.4.22/r25 to v0.4.23/r26 > Confirm update. Review reported unchanged website permissions.
nativeChrome.pageApplication: Normal reload of this task-owned tab at the exact requested URL after update; no test messages sent.

steps.action: Second previous click reaches first question
Next click returns to second question
Later full AX observation after asynchronous layout

nativeChrome.observation: Native AX action/readback. Landing was confirmed by own-question navigation state and remaining enabled bottom control; no new pixel-coordinate measurement or final screenshot is claimed.

environment.service: Original npm run dev restored only after prior writer had exited; retained running for daily use.
environment.recovery: Missing built-in resources produced E_BUILTIN_RESOURCE before service recovery. All 29 recovered built-ins matched manifest bytes/hashes at recovery check.
environment.parallelChanges: Existing provenance guards retained. Concurrent owner source/pin changes were not edited or reverted. One import was interrupted by dev reload and then retried before confirmation.
environment.sourceOwnership: Only Page project business implementation changed for this fix; Browser framework source was not edited by this task.

limits: Only already-observed verified rounds are remembered; unseen full server history is not inferred.
Custom adapters do not inherit ChatGPT history semantics.
DeepSeek/Gemini live-site paths, full history matrix, production Browser, release acceptance and independent scoring were not run.
